hooks.job: Hooks on every file and the commit messages
hooks.reason: always runs: it holds the privacy scan, the secret scan and the commit-message check, which never skip

infra.job: Static checks of the Terraform and Ansible code

the playbook and roles that the syntax check reads
make setup installs it: it pins ansible-core, which runs the syntax check

guards.job: Planted faults through the real commit path

paths.reason: make setup installs it: it pins pre-commit, Ruff and MyPy, whose messages the cases match
the Ruff and MyPy settings that the hooks of every planted commit apply
the privacy hook reads it, and an entry could allow a planted privacy marker
decides which files the suite copies and that its planted files are visible to Git
